 'Man United get in their own way' published at 14:24 GMT 14:24 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 It's a club that for so many years has looked like it's getting in its own way. 
 Patience is required, which is difficult when a club like United has had so much success and has so many expectations.

 Leny Yoro reads the ball into the box and knocks it behind for another Chelsea corner. 
 162 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Easier to replace manager than whole team' published at 14:23 GMT 14:23 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Mark Schwarzer 
Former Chelsea goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Stamford Bridge 
 It is easier to replace a manager than replace the whole team. 
 Unfortunately, when clubs do make the decision, generally it is the manager to go.
 For me, this is not on Michael Carrick. It is a senior player being sent off, which is crazy.

 That is difficult to take, he meets it absolutely perfect. What a strike from Bryan Mbeumo.

 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Josh Acheampong has the freedom of Stamford Bridge as he strides forward. 
 The ball finds Cole Palmer in the D but he sweeps his effort over the top. Poor.

 Surely that is the end of Martinez at this club. All bark, but no bite in recent times.
 Shiv, Canada 
 I'm a lifelong Man Utd supporter, but today's the end. The only person that actually cares is the manager and he'll be gone shortly. Relegation could get rid of the players and owners and that is what they deserve!
 Richard, Basingstoke

 Xabio Alonso makes changes with Moises Caicedo, Pedro Neto and Estevao making way for Valentin Barco, Danny Welbeck and Malo Gusto. 
 A huge ovation for Estevao as he makes his way to the bench. 
 Image source, Getty Images

 Post published at 86 mins 86 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 It's a good save in fairness. 
 322 126 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 86 mins 86 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Estevao has looked really lively on his first start of the season. He links well with Cole Palmer and fires one towards the bottom corner but Senne Lammens gets down to it. 
 421 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Defiant Man Utd fans published at 14:13 GMT 14:13 GMT 
 Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Manchester United reporter at Stamford Bridge 
 Manchester United's fans are going through their songs of defiance.
 "We'll never die", 'football taught by Matt Busby'.
 They can at least go home tonight and know they did the name of their club proud.
 As for Michael Carrick, it is one of those in between days. His team did well in the first half, gave away a poor opener and an experienced player let everyone down.
 It will be nine without a win now in all competitions. That's the worst since 1988-89.
 872 498 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United 
 Fair play to the United fans who are still inside Stamford Bridge. They're the ones making all of the noise at the moment.
